files_summary.categories.json: Array of KB categories (category_id, name, description).
files_summary.articles.json: Array of KB articles (article_id, title, category_id, tags, body, views).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: list_categories
tool_schemas.description: List KB categories, optional name substring filter and limit.

tool_schemas.name: get_category
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single knowledge-base category by category_id and returns the category when it exists, or indicates it was not found when it does not. Refuses requests that omit category_id or provide a non-string/empty identifier because the category cannot be looked up. Refuses identifiers that do not correspond to any category by reporting it as not found.

tool_schemas.name: list_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tag objects and returns a paginated set of results, optionally sorted by name or tag_id in ascending or descending order. Refuses requests with a limit less than 1, an unsupported sort field or order value, or unexpected extra parameters because they do not match the supported listing options. Refuses a cursor that is invalid or no longer usable because it cannot resume pagination from it.

cursor.description: Optional pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort.description: Optional sort field for returned tags.

tool_schemas.name: kb_get_article
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single knowledge-base article by article_id and returns the article when it exists, or indicates it was not found when it does not. Refuses requests that omit article_id or provide a non-string/empty identifier because the article cannot be looked up. Refuses identifiers that do not correspond to any article by reporting it as not found.

tool_schemas.name: kb_search
tool_schemas.description: Performs a case-insensitive full-text search over article titles and bodies for the given query and returns matching articles up to the optional limit. Refuses requests missing query or with an empty/non-string query because there is nothing to search for. Refuses a non-integer or out-of-range limit value because it cannot apply the requested result cap.

tool_schemas.name: kb_update_article
tool_schemas.description: Updates the specified article’s title and/or body and returns the updated article record. Refuses requests that omit article_id, provide an unknown article_id, or do not include at least one of title or body because there is no valid target or change to apply. Refuses updates where title or body is present but not a string because the article content must be text.

metadata.name: HelioSupport Knowledge Hub
metadata.description: A backend knowledge-base service that organizes help articles by categories and tags and provides APIs to retrieve, search, and update content.
